title: Green synthesis of gamma-valerolactone (GVL) through hydrogenation of biomass-derived levulinic acid using non-noble metal catalysts: A critical review

extraction_issues.quote: i.e., 92% LA conversion with 100% GVL selectivity at 50 bar H2 (400 °C, 4 h)
extraction_issues.reason: 该句与前文第18页（PDF extracted page 18）中“In solvent-free condition, Ni/Al2O3 was reported to achieve 92% LA conversion with 100% GVL selectivity (4 h, 200 °C, 50 bar H2)”及表2中对应的200 °C条件矛盾，400 °C应为200 °C的误写或抽取错误。

extraction_issues.quote: catalysts containing Ni particles with sizes of smaller than 10 mm showed the highest activity
extraction_issues.reason: 前文同段提到Ni/Al2O3平均粒径6 nm，此处“10 mm”显然应为“10 nm”，属于单位抽取/排版错误。

unverified_issue_candidates.quote: compared to its Al2O3-, ZnO-, and SiOsupported counterparts
unverified_issue_candidates.reason: “SiOsupported”缺少下标数字，应为“SiO2-supported”，但不影响理解。

self_check: 已核对摘要、正文数据与结论方向一致。关键数值如GVL物性（mp −31 °C, bp 207 °C, flash 96 °C）、LD50、燃料能量、Ni/NiO生产率14.1 mmol g⁻¹ h⁻¹、ZrO2/SBA-15选择性、Cu浸出数据等均来自原文。不确定处：表2中部分行数据与正文描述不完全吻合（如5 wt% Ni/Al2O3），但正文明确给出的数值均已采用，表值未逐一核对；已标记400 °C与10 mm两处矛盾。无公式需要保留。
